product-discovery.may: cluster synthetic signals, draft hypothesis and baseline
product-discovery.cannot: decide product scope or use passenger data

experience-design.may: sketch a journey and exception states

bounded-implementation.may: propose a small code change and failing-then-passing test

independent-verification.may: check contract, negative cases, accessibility and trace
independent-verification.cannot: self-certify a fix or infer dietary truth

rollout-observer.may: report pilot metrics, cost, drift and recurrence
rollout-observer.cannot: release, rollback or change a booking
